summary: InterContinental Hotels Group filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases through Goldman Sachs International under existing shareholder authority. Each dated exhibit discloses purchases of 1,000 ordinary shares at average prices around $154–$160, with all shares intended for cancellation. These transactions reduce issued share capital and return capital to shareholders, representing an ongoing buyback program rather than a one-time event. The filings do not indicate a tender offer, special dividend, or other extraordinary capital return. Regulatory details are minimal, and the program continues via standing instructions. What to watch: cumulative buyback pace and any update to the repurchase authority.
